items.title: Joe Robichaux Interview, 1959-03-19
items.q: I had a piano player that used to call Game Kid... he used to come and play the piano.

ctx.x: You can just sit back and relax. I'll pick up everything. Can you remember the first music, how you got interested in music? The first music you heard?

Well, I'll tell you how I actually got interested in playing music. I was quite a young kid and I had a piano player that used to call Game Kid. And my mother had a piano in that time, I think it was around about 1907. And I was quite small and he used to come and play the piano. And at that time, all the piano players were very famous around New Orleans at that time. And I kind of liked the piano, but I didn't, I wasn't interested in learning then, but I used to just like to listen. And I met a little fellow…
Was that up on St. Charles Avenue?
